content:
I'd like to promote a new feature on Leanweb: Collaboration allows you to look at shared code in the webeditor and edit it simultaneously:


The feature is available at lean.math.hhu.de. Please try it out and provide feedback! Unfortunately, it's not yet available on live.lean-lang.org

It should allow up to 50 simultaneous connections and the code is shared peer-to-peer.

Two gotcha:

  • If you misspell room name or password you will create a separate room instead of seeing any error
  • The "project" (i.e. "mathlib" or "stable Lean") is not yet synced; every user should choose the same project to have the code evaluate the same way.

Big thanks to @Nilesh for this feature!
